results.title: 2026 Voter’s Guide - Florida commissioner of agriculture race, Democratic primary
results.description: As part of our commitment to providing you with what you need to make an informed decision in the 2026 elections, News 6 joined with the News Collaborative of Central Florida to present the Voting Central Florida 2026 Voter’s Guide. Here are the candidates for the Democratic primary for Florida agricultural commissioner.

results.title: ‘Very loved’ Army hero Rampersad, who was killed in Iranian attack, laid to rest in front of hundreds of sobbing mourners in Queens
results.description: Throngs of mourners flooded the Calvary Assembly of God in Ozone Park to commemorate the life of Sgt. Angel S. Rampersad, 28, before an NYPD-flanked motorcade spanning several blocks headed out to Long Island where she was interred.
